_conditions: RTX 3090, 800x800, batch 1, FP32, CUDA-synced per image, torch 2.1.0+cu118, ultralytics 8.4.33. Latencies are from minimum-contention sessions (see _warning): iSAID full 5541-image val (2026-07-14), NWPU full 130-image val (2026-07-15). YOLO11m includes NMS; YOLO26m is end-to-end (NMS-free); Mask R-CNN forward includes its internal transform+RPN+RoI+postprocess. YOLO params/GFLOPs are for the fused (deploy) model.
_warning: This is a shared desktop: concurrent apps (browser etc.) delay CUDA kernel launches and inflate measured latency up to ~1.7x at only 30-40% GPU util (verified 2026-07-15). Re-measure only on a quiet machine; sanity-check that YOLO11m iSAID and NWPU latencies agree (~13 ms) since the architecture and input size are identical.
